title: Machine learning and Bayesian optimization guide ion-selective electrode cation sensors
summary: Machine-learning models were trained on 1745 literature data sets for PVC-membrane ion-selective electrodes (R2 = 0.75), Morgan fingerprints screened ionophores, and Bayesian optimization proposed material combinations. Fabricated Na+, Mg2+ and Al3+ sensors showed Nernst slopes within 8.2% of the ideal value and detection limits at the 10-7 M level.
ai_technology: Machine-learning models with Morgan-fingerprint ionophore screening and Bayesian optimization

evidence.tested: Fabricated Na+, Mg2+ and Al3+ sensors tested experimentally against Nernst slope and detection limit.
evidence.unknown: Model R2 is 0.75; only three ions fabricated; abstract only; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Models predicted sensor performance from literature data and Bayesian optimization proposed the sensor compositions.
